description: The card of a file change (lib/approval-preview.mjs): the bounds (20 files, 200 rows, 400 characters, 120,000 characters, 500 characters of a refusal), a line cut at a character and not inside one, the guard of every file of the call and the digest of the arguments, and the body of a private key hidden by its place in the old and the new text, judged by tests/verify-approval-preview.mjs. After the audit of PR #103: the key in one line, PGP's frames, the rows' keys hidden before they are cut.

mutations.name: AP-files-more
mutations.what: twenty-one files on the card

mutations.name: AP-rows-more
mutations.what: two hundred and one rows of a file

mutations.name: AP-row-chars-more
mutations.what: a line is cut at 401 characters

mutations.name: AP-chars-more
mutations.what: the card holds 130,000 characters

mutations.name: AP-message-more
mutations.what: the message of a refusal is cut at 5000 characters

mutations.name: AP-canonical-sort
mutations.what: the keys of the arguments are not sorted

mutations.name: AP-clip-ending
mutations.what: the line ending is counted in the line

mutations.name: AP-clip-surrogate
mutations.what: a character can be cut in two

mutations.name: AP-clip-omitted
mutations.what: a cut line says it lost all its characters

mutations.name: AP-clip-end
mutations.what: a cut line loses its line ending

mutations.name: AP-clip-limit
mutations.what: a line of exactly the limit is cut

mutations.name: AP-keys-begin
mutations.what: a BEGIN frame never opens a key

mutations.name: AP-keys-end
mutations.what: the END frame of a line that has both frames is ignored (a key in one line stays open)

mutations.name: AP-keys-body
mutations.what: the lines of a private key body are not hidden

mutations.name: AP-keys-public
mutations.what: a public key is taken for a private one

patches.old: export const PRIVATE_KEY_BEGIN = String.raw`-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;
export const PRIVATE_KEY_END = String.raw`-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.name: AP-keys-lead
mutations.what: the rows before the first change are counted wrong

mutations.name: AP-keys-old
mutations.what: the place in the old text does not move

mutations.name: AP-keys-current
mutations.what: the place in the new text does not move

mutations.name: AP-keys-removed
mutations.what: a removed row is looked up in the new text

mutations.name: AP-keys-added
mutations.what: an added row is looked up in the old text

mutations.name: AP-keys-ending
mutations.what: a hidden row loses its line ending

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag
mutations.what: the card does not say that a call touches a private key

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-old
mutations.what: a key that goes away is not key material

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-new
mutations.what: a key that appears is not key material

mutations.name: AP-keys-old-text
mutations.what: the old text of a plan is not looked at

patches.old: const oldLines = typeof plan.oldText === 'string' ? privateKeyBodyLines(plan.oldText) : new Set();

mutations.name: AP-keys-new-text
mutations.what: the new text of a plan is not looked at

patches.old: const newLines = typeof plan.newText === 'string' ? privateKeyBodyLines(plan.newText) : new Set();

mutations.name: AP-guard-all
mutations.what: the guard holds the files of the card only

patches.old: files: plans.map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };
patches.new: files: plans.slice(0, PREVIEW_LIMITS.files).map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };

mutations.name: AP-guard-sha
mutations.what: the guard holds the path and not the hash

mutations.name: AP-guard-tool
mutations.what: a card made for another tool is accepted

mutations.name: AP-guard-args
mutations.what: a card made for other arguments is accepted

mutations.name: AP-guard-files
mutations.what: a card with no list of files is accepted

mutations.name: AP-hidden-files
mutations.what: the files that are not on the card are not counted

mutations.name: AP-truncated-files
mutations.what: files that are not shown do not make the card truncated

mutations.name: AP-rows-hidden
mutations.what: the rows that are not shown are not counted

mutations.name: AP-rows-cut
mutations.what: a hunk that is cut does not say how much

mutations.name: AP-action-create
mutations.what: a new file is an overwrite

mutations.name: AP-error-code
mutations.what: a refusal without a code has none

mutations.name: AP-keys-body-words
mutations.what: a line of a body that says "PRIVATE KEY" in words is not hidden

mutations.name: AP-keys-stray-end
mutations.what: an END frame does not close a key that is open

mutations.name: AP-keys-first-frame
mutations.what: the first frame of a line counts, not the last

patches.old: for (const match of line.matchAll(frames)) at = match.index;
patches.new: for (const match of line.matchAll(frames)) { at = match.index; break; }

mutations.name: AP-keys-pgp-begin
mutations.what: the BEGIN frame of a PGP private key is not recognised

patches.old: export const PRIVATE_KEY_BEGIN = String.raw`-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.name: AP-keys-pgp-end
mutations.what: the END frame of a PGP private key is not recognised

patches.old: export const PRIVATE_KEY_END = String.raw`-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.name: AP-keys-fast-path
mutations.what: the line without the words PRIVATE KEY is not skipped at once
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: a line without the words has no frame, and the check after it gives the same answer

mutations.name: AP-inline-marker
mutations.what: the key in a row is cut out and nothing is put in its place

mutations.name: AP-inline-end-frame
mutations.what: the END frame of a key in a row is cut out with the key

mutations.name: AP-inline-nested
mutations.what: a BEGIN frame inside a key in a row starts another key

mutations.name: AP-inline-no-break
mutations.what: a BEGIN frame with no END after it makes every later one read the line again (a megabyte of frames takes minutes)

patches.old: if (!closing) break; // no END frame to the right of this one: none to the right of the next ones either
patches.new: if (!closing) continue; // no END frame to the right of this one: none to the right of the next ones either

mutations.name: AP-inline-not-applied
mutations.what: the rows are cut to 400 characters before a key in them is hidden

mutations.name: AP-inline-row-kind
mutations.what: a row whose key is hidden loses its kind

patches.old: return text === row.text ? row : { kind: row.kind, text };
patches.new: return text === row.text ? row : { kind: 'context', text };

mutations.name: AP-holds-body
mutations.what: a call is not told to touch a key when the key is over several lines

patches.old: export const holdsPrivateKey = (text) => text.includes('PRIVATE KEY') && (privateKeyBodyLines(text).size > 0 || text.split('\n').some((line) => hideInlineKeys(line) !== line));
patches.new: export const holdsPrivateKey = (text) => text.includes('PRIVATE KEY') && (text.split('\n').some((line) => hideInlineKeys(line) !== line));

mutations.name: AP-holds-inline
mutations.what: a call is not told to touch a key when the key is in one line

patches.old: export const holdsPrivateKey = (text) => text.includes('PRIVATE KEY') && (privateKeyBodyLines(text).size > 0 || text.split('\n').some((line) => hideInlineKeys(line) !== line));

mutations.name: AP-holds-guard
mutations.what: holdsPrivateKey reads the lines of a text that does not say PRIVATE KEY
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: a text without the words has no frame, and the two checks after it give the same answer

patches.old: export const holdsPrivateKey = (text) => text.includes('PRIVATE KEY') && (privateKeyBodyLines(text).size > 0 || text.split('\n').some((line) => hideInlineKeys(line) !== line));
patches.new: export const holdsPrivateKey = (text) => true && (privateKeyBodyLines(text).size > 0 || text.split('\n').some((line) => hideInlineKeys(line) !== line));
